title: Dynamic Music Playlist Manager
problemStatement: Design a music playlist manager using a doubly linked list. The playlist supports the following operations: addSong(title) removeSong(title) playNext() playPrevious() moveSong(title, position) currentSong() Initially, the playlist is empty. Process a sequence of operations and print the result for every playNext(), playPrevious(), and currentSong() operation.
output: Print the result for every query operation.
constraints: 1 <= q <= 2 × 10^5 Song titles contain printable ASCII characters.
